title.en: Forests and the Politics of Environmental Transformation
title.zh: 中国林业：森林与环境改造的政治

summary.en: A discussion of forest destruction and afforestation in China, the organization of forestry work, and how local cases can reshape broader historical interpretations.
summary.zh: 从毁林与造林的关系切入，讨论林业劳动的组织，以及局部案例如何修正更广泛的历史解释。

en: What did it mean to conquer nature in a particular forestry project?
How did expertise, administrative priorities, and everyday needs interact?
What evidence connects local cases with broader historical claims?
zh: 具体林业项目中的“征服自然”意味着什么？
专业知识、行政目标与日常需求如何相互作用？
局部案例与总体历史解释之间需要怎样的证据？

title.en: China’s Constitution: Formation and Political Practice
title.zh: 中国宪法：制度形成与政治实践

time.zh: 晚 7–8 点 · 太平洋时间

location.en: Meeting Room, C. V. Starr East Asian Library · UC Berkeley
location.zh: 伯克利 C. V. Starr 东亚图书馆 · 会议室

summary.en: An introductory discussion of what China’s constitution does, approached through the formation of political institutions, with the Dual State model as a starting point.
summary.zh: 从政治发生学的视角，初步理解中国宪法在做什么，并以 Dual State 模型作为讨论的起点。

title.en: A Conversation with Laura Wen-yu Young
title.zh: 与 Laura Wen-yu Young 对谈

time.zh: 晚 7–8 点 · 太平洋时间

location.en: Seminar Room 341, C. V. Starr East Asian Library · UC Berkeley
location.zh: 伯克利 C. V. Starr 东亚图书馆 · 341 研讨室

summary.en: An informal conversation about legal education and careers in law, with guest remarks followed by open discussion.
summary.zh: 围绕法律教育与职业经历的轻松对谈，嘉宾分享后开放讨论。

title.en: Metaphysics Across Cultures: Daoism, Aristotle, Kant, and Kafka
title.zh: 形而上学：道家、亚里士多德、康德与卡夫卡

summary.en: A discussion of metaphysical questions across Daoist thought, the philosophies of Aristotle and Kant, and Kafka’s fiction.
summary.zh: 以道家思想、亚里士多德与康德的哲学和卡夫卡的文学作品为切入点，比较不同传统如何提出和处理形而上学问题。

title.en: Building a Digital Archive from San Francisco’s Chee Kung Tong Records
title.zh: 旧金山致公堂档案数字化

time.zh: 晚 7–9 点 · 太平洋时间

summary.en: A discussion of a digital archive built from the records of the Chee Kung Tong’s San Francisco lodge, combining a searchable catalog with a map and timeline for exploring the records by place and date.
summary.zh: 讨论以旧金山致公堂堂口的档案为基础，介绍如何将这些材料整理成可检索的数字档案。项目将档案目录与地图、时间轴结合，便于按地点和年代查阅相关记录。

title.en: Chinese Opera and Male Performers of Female Roles in the Ming and Qing Dynasties
title.zh: 明清的戏曲与优伶文化

summary.en: An examination of Chinese opera culture in the Ming and Qing dynasties, focusing on male performers who played female roles.
summary.zh: 从男演员扮演女性角色的舞台实践切入，讨论明清戏曲中的优伶及其所处的演出文化。

title.en: Personal, Family, Lineage, and the State: Social Transformation in Twentieth-Century China and Family History Research
title.zh: 个人、家庭、家族与国家：二十世纪中国社会变迁与家族史研究

location.en: Seminar Room 341, C. V. Starr East Asian Library · UC Berkeley
location.zh: 伯克利 C. V. Starr 东亚图书馆 · 341 研讨室

summary.en: Beginning with the speaker’s Chinese translation of Joseph W. Esherick’s Ancestral Leaves, this lecture draws on more than two decades of research into the papers of the Chou family and on the archives of Chinese scholars overseas. It explores how private documents can reconstruct historical contexts and illuminate the interplay of individual, family, lineage, and state in twentieth-century China.
summary.zh: 从翻译周锡瑞（Joseph W. Esherick）教授《叶：百年动荡中的一个中国家庭》谈起，结合二十余年整理周馥、周学熙、周叔弢、周一良等周氏家族文献的研究，以及对海外中国学人档案的考察，探讨如何从私人文献重建历史情境，理解个人、家庭、家族与国家在二十世纪中国社会变迁中的互动。

title.en: From an Enemy to a Potential Partner: The P.R.C.’s Often-Overlooked Relationship with the U.S. (Oct. 1949–Apr. 1971)
title.zh: 从敌人到潜在伙伴：常被忽视的中美关系（1949 年 10 月—1971 年 4 月）

summary.en: A look at relations between the People’s Republic of China and the United States from the founding of the PRC in October 1949 to the ping-pong diplomacy of April 1971. The period is usually remembered for hostility and isolation; the discussion follows how the two countries moved from enemies toward potential partners well before rapprochement.
summary.zh: 回顾 1949 年 10 月中华人民共和国成立至 1971 年 4 月“乒乓外交”之间的中美关系。这段时期常被概括为敌对与隔绝，讨论将关注两国如何在正式和解之前，逐步从敌人走向潜在伙伴。

title.en: Book Talk with Liu Zongkun: Lives Remembered and Roads Traveled

time.zh: 下午 2–4 点 · 太平洋时间

location.en: Seminar Room 341, C. V. Starr East Asian Library · UC Berkeley
location.zh: 伯克利 C. V. Starr 东亚图书馆 · 341 研讨室

summary.en: A book talk on Liu Zongkun’s essay collection, published by 1 Plus Books in 2026. The essays revisit people he knew in China, met over two decades in Texas, and encountered while walking and cycling abroad. Their stories raise a question familiar to many who have moved away: what makes a place home?
summary.zh: 散文集《异乡故人》（壹嘉出版，2026）新书分享。书中写到作者在中国故乡的亲友师长、移居得克萨斯二十余年间结识的人，以及徒步与骑行途中偶遇的陌生人。作者借这些人物故事，回望移居经历，追问故乡与归属的意义。
